answer_summary: Derived ΔrH298 = -802.3 kJ mol^-1 and ΔrH2000 = -781.876 kJ mol^-1, then used PV = nRT to obtain the exact raw energy 4357297213500000000/619393 J for the printed methane volume. Under the intended one-day flow basis this is 7.03478601388779e12 J day^-1 and reports to 7.03e12 J day^-1 at three significant figures. The printed flow unit omits its time denominator, so the numerical daily value is explicitly conditional rather than claimed unconditionally.
assumptions: Complete gaseous methane combustion has stoichiometry CH4 + 2 O2 -> CO2 + 2 H2O(g).
The standard formation enthalpy of O2 in its elemental standard state is zero.
The printed heat capacities are treated as constant from 298 K to 2000 K, as required by the supplied constant-ΔrCp enthalpy equation.
For the boxed numeric candidate only, the printed 2.2e5 m^3 is interpreted as the methane volume delivered in one day.
Energy released is reported as the positive magnitude of the negative combustion enthalpy.
source_gaps: On T4 question page 3 / PDF page 39 the volumetric-flow datum Q = 2.2e5 is printed with unit m^3 and no time denominator. The requested J day^-1 value is therefore not uniquely determined literally. For an interval of tau days, the daily energy is 7.03478601388779e12/tau J day^-1; the displayed numeric answer uses tau = 1.
